customer: Hi, my midsize SUV won't start anymore. Can I still sell it to Northwind Auto? I'm in Georgia.
agent: Thanks for reaching out, and I'm sorry to hear your SUV won't start. As explained in our article "Selling a car that doesn't run," we don't buy cars that don't run or can't be driven safely to a store. Since yours won't start, a local salvage buyer may be a better option for you.
